# Video source index

Research date: **25 October 2026, Asia/Kolkata**. Requested publication window: **25 April–25 October 2026 inclusive**. Recent priority window: **25 July–25 October 2026**.

## Verification and evidence

The actual [channel Videos listing](https://www.youtube.com/@TimGabe/videos), sorted Latest, was inspected through the browser. Exact dates below came from expanded descriptions on individual YouTube watch pages, not calculations from “months ago.” Titles and IDs were read from the channel and watch pages.

**A** = YouTube English auto-generated transcript exported and read. Useful for reasoning and timestamp navigation; names, figures, and transcription may be wrong. Not equivalent to human-reviewed captions.
**C** = description exposes a “Show transcript” control, but captions were not analyzed.
**V** = selected actual playback frames inspected at the ranges noted. Not full-video viewing.

For A sources, use each linked watch page → expanded description → Show transcript. No independent public transcript-host permalink was verified. Do not treat transcript aggregators or search snippets as reviewed evidence. Transcripts were used privately, not reproduced in this package.

## Description and access notes

Most expanded descriptions contained a brief agency-call promotion, not detailed design reasoning. The October 22 description additionally introduces Tim, the Zipzap studio, and end-to-end product design services. Chapter labels helped navigation where present. No full descriptions or transcripts are reproduced.

Search-service access to the channel returned only a footer, and direct watch-page fetches were throttled/disabled. Browser-based channel inspection and YouTube's transcript export succeeded. One neobank export was attempted too early and succeeded after the page loaded. No paid service, download-every-video workflow, or paywall bypass was used.

Actual frames were small browser-player captures. They support broad palette, image, and composition observations; they do not support measured font sizes, pixel spacing, precise shadow settings, full interaction verification, or independent business outcomes. The thumbnail is distinct from a playback frame.

This is a dated public Videos-tab inventory, not a guaranteed archive of deleted/private/unlisted content or a Shorts/Live catalogue. No later October 25 uploads can be ruled out. Dates are YouTube's displayed calendar dates; upload-time timezone boundaries were not separately resolved.

These references ground technical compatibility and checks; they are not evidence for the creator's visual methodology.

Brand-spelling note: the observed card mark reads “solcard”; auto-captions render the name inconsistently. This package uses Solcard and does not treat caption spelling as authoritative.
